description: 2026-05-23 — ADR-0012 amendment regression guard for the Normal-mode break-aligned active-window extension. A Normal-mode clip whose timeline-end aligns with a section break AND has source content past that point extends its active window past clip.duration up to the source out point: during the at-break park the continuation phase advances the source-frame via wall-clock, and after Section GO the postBreakMediaAnchor + the 3-arg mapToMediaFrame's extended-realEnd math resume natural playback past clipEnd to extendedEnd. Setup mirrors section_break_tail_no_freeze.json (tone_1khz.mov is 150 source frames at 30fps; SetClipDuration to 30 makes the authored window 30 frames but extendedDuration = ceil(150/1) = 150 so the active window grows to 150). SectionBehavior defaults to Normal — verifies the new extension path, not held-frame behavior.
